description.text: Objective This objective is to train students to be able to work as teachers teaching sciences, physics, chemistry, biology and other courses in middle and primary schools or to work in institutions of higher learning, research institutions as professional personnel in the fields of teaching, scientific research or administration. Core courses Natural Geography, University Chemistry, University Physics, University Biology, Analytical Chemistry, Organic Chemistry, Physical Chemistry, Electromagnetics, Structural Chemistry, Genetics, Science Course and Teaching Theory. Schooling Length In standards it lasts four years. The minimum of schooling length must be three years and its extension lasts no more than seven years. Credits The minimum of 170 credits must be obtained for graduation. Diploma Bachelor of Education or Science is granted.

duration.text: The Science Education at Sichuan Normal University is a 4 Years long program for international students, taught in Chinese.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 2083 USD/per year ￥ 15000 CNY/per year

materials.text: 1. Photocopy of valid passport With photo, passport number &expiration date and name included. 2. Passport-sized photo A passport-sized photo taken recently of the applicant. 3. Graduation certificate of high school Graduation certificate should be in Chinese or English.If not, it should be translated into Chinese or English and be notarized. 4. Academic transcript of high school 5. HSK Certificate (No need for English-taught program) Certificate of HSK (Chinese Proficiency Test) 6. Health certificate(optional) Photocopy of physical examination record. 7.Certification of no criminal record 8.Copy of insurance policy 9.Photocopies of personal artwork Those who apply for artistic major should supply materials to prove your art level.

requirements.text: 1.High school graduates 2.No criminal record 3.HSK level 3 or above
